What most systems see

Most risk systems focus on the vehicle.

They record what the truck does. They don't measure the person driving it.

The blind spot

Drivers cause 90% of accidents.

Telematics tracks behaviour, but it can't explain why high-risk incidents happen.

What Driver Bureau sees

We assess and train the driver.

AI-powered testing of reaction time, visual tracking and risk perception, followed by personalised EyeGym training.

Proactive. Personalised. Measurable.

Scroll to drive

Our belief

Driver risk management shouldn't be reactive. It should be proactive, personalised and measurable. We assess and train individual drivers, not just vehicles, using AI-driven insights to improve psychomotor skills and decision-making. The result is fewer accidents, lower costs and safer roads.

Driver Bureau is an independent company focused on addressing human error among drivers and operators.

Our cloud-based app profiles a driver's psychomotor ability, then delivers an individualised EyeGym training programme with AI-driven feedback on cognitive and physical performance.

The gap

90%

of accidents are caused by drivers. Yet most risk management systems focus on vehicles.

Driver Bureau's psychomotor assessments and training tackle the root cause of driver risk: cognitive and physical response ability.

  1. Telematics

    It records what happened, not why.

    Telematics tracks driver behaviour and detects risky events. It doesn't explain why high-risk incidents occur, and it doesn't deliver personalised interventions.

  2. Safety programmes

    They react after the incident.

    Standard safety programmes are reactive rather than preventative, and many drivers and operators are unaware of their own risk behaviours.

  3. Training

    It's the same for every driver.

    Standard training programmes don't personalise learning based on cognitive ability, so the drivers who need the most help get the same course as everyone else.

How it works

From assessment to measurable change.

One cloud-based app takes each driver from a psychomotor assessment to an individualised training programme.

  1. 01

    Assess

    App-based testing evaluates response times, visual tracking and risk perception. It measures reaction time, coordination and decision-making under pressure.

  2. 02

    Profile

    Automated, AI-individualised feedback identifies each driver's areas of concern. You see why incidents happen, at the level of the individual driver.

  3. 03

    Train

    EyeGym delivers customised daily 10-minute exercises that sharpen hand-eye-brain ability: quicker reactions, better observance, better decisions and a better ability to handle fatigue.

  4. 04

    Measure

    Elevate AI integrates with telematics and insurance risk models, so improvement shows up in the numbers you already track: harsh braking, acceleration, incidents and claims.

Case study · Large mining operation

From reactive safety to measurable change.

  1. Challenge
  2. Solution
  3. Results

The challenge

A mining operator was struggling with high rates of harsh braking and acceleration. That meant excessive fuel use, higher maintenance costs and preventable safety risks.

  • Operators were unaware of their own risk behaviours.
  • Standard safety programmes were reactive rather than preventative.
  • Telematics detected risky events but gave no personalised interventions.

The solution

The operator deployed Elevate AI, a psychomotor risk assessment, to identify high-risk operators and give each one targeted feedback.

It then expanded the programme to Elevate+, combining assessment with personalised cognitive training to improve situational awareness.

The results

Reduction in high-risk driving incidents
Up to 55%
Improvement in risk awareness and decision-making
28%
Estimated reduction in total crashes
9.24%

An Elevate AI session takes about 40 minutes. The VPJ assessment takes 45 minutes and is followed by ongoing EyeGym training: customised exercises of about 10 minutes a day.

Telematics tracks driver behaviour and flags risky events, but it doesn't explain why high-risk incidents happen. Driver Bureau assesses reaction time, cognitive function and risk perception at the driver level, then trains them. It works alongside your telematics.
